claims.statement: The 1457 catasto declaration of Antonio da Vinci lists Leonardo, illegitimate son of ser Piero, aged five, among the household (Itinerario tier A)

background.text: The first document of Leonardo's life is his grandfather's birth entry, which fixes the day of the week and the hour: an exceptionally precise starting point for a Renaissance artist. The years with his mother Caterina, the relation of the Anchiano farmhouse to the family, and the content of his village schooling all rest on later tradition and have no support in contemporary documents. What the 1457 catasto does establish is that by the age of five Leonardo belonged to his father's household in Vinci. The rural commune and the notarial family are the initial conditions of the whole itinerary: a childhood spent between agrarian terrain and a profession built on the written instrument.
